_note: The human-readable template and rationale live in docs/audits/phase1-security-exceptions.md.
This file is empty on purpose. On 2026-09-22 `pnpm audit --prod --json` reported
1 critical and 16 high production advisories, and no exception has been granted,
so the policy check fails by design. That failure is the release block, not a bug.
Every entry must carry all of: id, module, advisory, severity, owner, grantedOn,
expiresOn, rationale, reachability, compensatingControl, residualRisk, approvedBy.
Use "*" for module or advisory to match broadly. There is no open-ended exception:
expiry is a hard stop, and an entry that matches no current advisory is itself a
violation so the registry shrinks as findings are fixed.
Granting an exception is Anass's decision, not an agent's.
